name: Chang Yüeh
bio: Chang Yüeh (張說, 667–731) was a T’ang poet.

The poems here are from the Qianjiashi (千家詩, Poems of a Thousand Poets), the Song-Ming schoolroom anthology of Tang and Song verse attributed to Xie Fangde and Wang Xiang, taken from the chinese-poetry dataset (MIT); the original characters are given as printed there.

poems.title: 蜀道後期 (Shu dao hou qi)
poems.author: Chang Yüeh
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
客心爭日月，來往預期程。
秋風不相待，先至洛陽城。

poems.title: 恩賜麗正殿書院賜宴應制得林字 (En ci li zheng dian shu yuan ci yan ying zhi de lin zi)
poems.author: Chang Yüeh
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
東壁圖書府，西園翰墨林。
誦詩聞國政，講易見天心。
位竊和羹重，恩叨醉酒深。
載歌春興曲，情竭爲知音。

poems.title: 幽州夜歌 (You zhou ye ge)
poems.author: Chang Yüeh
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
涼風吹夜雨，蕭瑟動寒林。
正有高堂宴，能忘遲暮心。
軍中宜劍舞，塞上重笳音。
不作邊城將，誰知恩遇深。
